title: India Continues To Heat Up
summary:
Main
By Jeffrey Landsberg
As we discussed in Commodore Research's most recent Weekly Executive Report, India produced approximately 144.1 billion kilowatt hours of electricity last month. This is up month-on-month by 4.1 billion kilowatt hours (3%), up year-on-year by 10.4 billion kilowatt hours (8%), and is the largest amount ever produced in the month of August. India's electricity production has now increased year-on-year for five straight months.
